result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text elements overlap in the 'Popular right now' restaurant card.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now', the delivery time ('25-35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text elements overlap each other, making both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout or spacing (e.g., use a flex row with proper gap or separate text containers without fixed/negative positioning) so the delivery time and delivery fee are displayed side by side cleanly.
